environment.determinism_note: SGD sources are deterministic at the locked seed. CatBoost is seeded, but exact bytes can vary with CPU, OS, and thread scheduling; retraining uses numerical tolerance while artifact replay uses SHA-256.

holdout_protocol.rule: Local code may export only safe_input_columns. No local metric is produced for the reserved period.

transforms.rank: ascending within-user ordinal rank with stable row-order tie breaking
